title: Dallas Sightseeing Tour
includes: The listed price does not include a parking fee, payable at the time of tour check-in
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Accessibility Notice Please note that Fun Texas Tours vans are not wheelchair accessible. Guests who use wheelchairs or require special accommodations must contact Fun Texas Tours in advance at 214-728-8528 to discuss possible arrangements.
Texas law mandates that children under 8 years old, unless they are taller than 4 ft 9 in, must be secured in an appropriate Child Passenger Safety seat or booster seat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Dallas with the company recognized by travelers as one of the very best in the world. We are proud to be a Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Best of the Best winner for two consecutive years—Tripadvisor's highest honor, awarded only to businesses that consistently receive outstanding traveler reviews and rank among the top 1% of attractions and experiences worldwide.

This 3-hour small-group tour combines Dallas' most famous landmarks with engaging storytelling from knowledgeable local guides who bring the city's history and culture to life. Visit iconic sites including Pioneer Plaza, Dallas City Hall designed by I.M. Pei, the Dallas Arts District, Dealey Plaza, the JFK Memorial, and many other must-see attractions.

Unlike large bus tours, our small-group allow time for memorable photos at key stops. With convenient morning and afternoon departures, you'll enjoy a relaxed, informative, and unforgettable introduction to Dallas with the city's highest-rated tour company.
